## Change

What problem does this solve? What happens before and after?

## Validation

Commands run and results. Watch / phone / emulator versions actually tested. Screenshots with synthetic data for UI changes. List checks not run.

## AI usage

- Writing: agent(s)/tool(s), model(s), and role, or None.
- Implementation: agent(s)/tool(s), model(s), and role, or None / Not applicable.

Use Unknown / not exposed when the tool does not reveal its model. Include translation, investigation, testing, and review assistance where relevant. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
